t: 阿拔斯德·卡利弗·穆提被他的突厥将领萨布克塔金所逼退位,由他的儿子阿拔斯·塔伊接任.
te: Abbasid Caliph al-Muti' is forced to abdicate by his Turkic general Sabuktakin and succeeded by his son al-Ta'i'.
dz: 阿拔斯德·卡利弗·穆提被他的突厥将领萨布克塔金所逼退位,由他的儿子阿拔斯·塔伊接任.
de: Abbasid Caliph al-Muti' is forced to abdicate by his Turkic general Sabuktakin and succeeded by his son al-Ta'i'.
